name: The Entertainer
work_style: Social, energetic, and experience-driven. Bring life to teams and events. Work best in dynamic, people-facing environments where their warmth and spontaneity are assets. Not suited to solitary, analytical work.
decision_making: In-the-moment and people-aware. Trust their read of social dynamics. Benefit from explicit long-term planning support.
leadership_style: Lead through enthusiasm and genuine warmth. Build high morale. Need strong operational structure around them.
